sources.kind: previously retained official DevTools protocol schema snapshot
observations: Explicit runtime evaluation/await, lifecycle and network inventories
Browser environment/media overrides, isolated inspection worlds and private target lifecycle

decisions: Tighten the same operation context/token through a phase; never extend original/outer time or suppress expiry by disposing
Keep default document scripts disabled; caller promise execution is explicit, bounded and source-redacted
Use synchronous isolated native DOM/font/image snapshots and observed in-flight thresholds, avoiding script-disabled internal promise hangs
Preserve strict/permissive known asset losses; unsupported child-frame/worker/navigation profiles fail explicitly
Abort broken/crashed private hosts and create a fresh job without automatic authenticated/script replay
Keep the original six-argument binary constructor; only the expanded constructor has optional parameters, without analyzer suppression
limitations: A protocol snapshot and original fixtures are not a complete browser semantic/site or OS host qualification
Complete frame/worker/environment/corpus and exact supported-runtime/package qualification remain mandatory
